question: Average total spend per unique customer (LTV proxy)
gold_sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(customer_total), 2) AS avg_ltv
FROM (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, SUM(i.price + i.freight_value) AS customer_total
  FROM customers c
  JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
) AS sub
predicted_sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(customer_total_spend) as avg_total_spend_per_customer
FROM (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) as customer_total_spend
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
) as customer_spend;

question: Overall repeat customer rate (% of customers with > 1 order)
gold_sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN n_orders > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repeat_pct
FROM (
  SELECT customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS n_orders
  FROM customers GROUP BY customer_unique_id
) AS sub
predicted_sql:
SELECT 
    (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN customer_unique_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id)) AS repeat_customer_rate
FROM (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
) AS customer_orders;

question: Top 5 sellers by number of distinct customer states served
gold_sql:
SELECT T1.seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT T3.customer_state) AS n_states
FROM sellers T1
JOIN order_items T2 ON T1.seller_id = T2.seller_id
JOIN orders T4 ON T2.order_id = T4.order_id
JOIN customers T3 ON T4.customer_id = T3.customer_id
GROUP BY T1.seller_id
ORDER BY n_states DESC, T1.seller_id
LIMIT 5
predicted_sql:
SELECT 
    s.seller_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_state) as distinct_customer_states
FROM sellers s
JOIN order_items oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY s.seller_id
ORDER BY distinct_customer_states DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: On-time delivery rate
gold_sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date <= order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_on_time
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
predicted_sql:

    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date <= o.order_estimated_delivery_date) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS on_time_delivery_rate
FROM orders o
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL;

question: Top 5 product categories by total revenue (price + freight)
gold_sql:
SELECT T3.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(T1.price + T1.freight_value), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items T1
JOIN products T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_translation T3 ON T2.product_category_name = T3.product_category_name
GROUP BY T3.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5
predicted_sql:
SELECT 
    COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) as category,
    SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) as total_revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_translation pct 
    ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
GROUP BY COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: Payment method distribution (with share %)
gold_sql:
SELECT payment_type,
       COUNT(*) AS n,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_payments), 2) AS pct
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY n DESC
predicted_sql:
SELECT 
    op.payment_type,
    COUNT(op.payment_type) as payment_count,
    ROUND(COUNT(op.payment_type) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(op.payment_type)) OVER (), 2) as payment_share_percentage
FROM order_payments op
GROUP BY op.payment_type
ORDER BY payment_count DESC
LIMIT 100;
